about: A project's scope (project_scope::Project): the specifications its sections list, their names, the order a run builds them in and what refuses that run before any is built, which a project check reports too where a run of every section would refuse it (a producer cycle, #5077), and a saved link's artifact read at its path. DM is listed in SDTM, ADSL and ADAE in ADaM, both linked to DM, and ADAE to ADSL. Moved from project_scope.rs, whose tests compared the fields each case's compares names; a case with no issues states a question its test found empty, and the absent project file is read and checked against one request, which report the same complete rows, as its test compared them.

files.sdtm/vs.yaml:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
model: SDTM
domain: VS
keys: [USUBJID, VSTESTCD]
submission: {mode: reproduced, label: Vital Signs, class: FINDINGS, structure: One record per test per subject, repeating: true}
input:
  SRC: {path: ../src.csv, types: {USUBJID: str, VSTESTCD: str, VSORRES: str}}
output: {path: ../out/vs.csv, columns: [USUBJID, VSTESTCD, VSORRES]}
columns:
  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: SRC.USUBJID
    submission:
      data_type: text
      mandatory: true
      length: 20
      origins: [{type: Collected, source: Investigator}]
  - name: VSTESTCD
    type: str
    label: Vital Signs Test Short Name
    derivation: SRC.VSTESTCD
    submission:
      data_type: text
      mandatory: true
      length: 8
      origins: [{type: Assigned, source: Sponsor}]
  - name: VSORRES
    type: str
    label: Result or Finding in Original Units
    derivation: SRC.VSORRES
    submission:
      data_type: text
      mandatory: false
      length: 20
      origins: [{type: Other, source: Sponsor, description: Entered by the site.}]
      value_level:
        - id: TEMP
          where: {VSTESTCD: [TEMP]}
          origins: [{type: Derived, source: Vendor}]
          method: Converted by the vendor.
